ITEM 1A.    RISK FACTORS
Our operations and financial results are subject to various risks and uncertainties, including those described below.
Risks Related to Our Business and Industry
We generate a significant portion of our revenues from advertising. Reduced spending by advertisers could harm our business.
We generated over 75% of total revenues from online advertising in 2025.
Many advertisers can reduce or cancel their spending at any time.
We face intense competition.
Our business environment is rapidly evolving and intensely competitive.
